title: #Summerforthecity at @Lincoln Center is one of my favorite events of ...
transcript: Have you been wondering why there's a giant disco ball in the middle of Lincoln Center? It's a part of their annual summer for the city event, which hosts a ton of free events throughout the months of June, July, and into August. These events range from live music to dance classes to comedy to theater. The day I was there, they did a free reading of a musical starring Andrew Ryan Feldman, Eden Espinosa, and Katrina Lenk. And then I also got to see a production of waitress from Deaf Broadway, which was a slightly truncated two hour version of the musical told entirely through American Sign Language. And of course, because it was waitress, I had to grab a pie crust cookie from Janie's. Life changing goods. It was like half pie, half cookie. It was very good. They actually have food trucks all throughout the grounds. For dinner, I tried Chef Kwame's Patty Palace, which was a delicious curry chicken sandwich, but if that's not your vibe, they also had a Cuban food truck and a gelato stand. Although be warned, the food trucks do rotate, so it's not gonna be the same food every day. So if you're in New York, I highly recommend checking out summer for the city. Like I said, all of the events are free. They have some really cool ones coming up, including a Warriors album listening party hosted by Lin Manuel Miranda. But you can check out the full schedule of events On Lincoln Center dot org.
